v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.en: The Lord hath inclined * his ear unto me.

text.la: Vota mea * Dómino reddam coram omni pópulo eius.
text.en: I will pay my vows * in the sight of all his people.
I have cried to the Lord, * and he hath heard me.

text.la: Auxílium meum * a Dómino, qui fecit cælum et terram.
text.en: My help is from the Lord, * who made heaven and earth.

text.la: Lætátus sum * in his, quæ dicta sunt mihi. ‡
text.en: I rejoiced * at the things that were said to me. ‡

text.la: Ecce sacérdos magnus, qui in diébus suis plácuit Deo, et invéntus est iustus: et in témpore iracúndiæ factus est reconciliátio.
text.en: Behold an high priest, who in his days pleased God, and was found righteous, and in the time of wrath he was made a propitiation.

v.la: Iustum dedúxit Dóminus per vias rectas.
v.en: The Lord guided the just in right paths.

r.en: And showed him the kingdom of God.

text.la: Dum esset Summus Póntifex, * terréna non métuit, sed ad cæléstia regna gloriósus migrávit.
text.en: While he was supreme Pontiff, * he feared not earthly powers, but gloriously went his way to the heavenly kingdom.

text.la: Gregem tuum, Pastor ætérne, placátus inténde: et, per beátum Dámasum Summum Pontíficem, perpétua protectióne custódi; quem totíus Ecclésiæ præstitísti esse pastórem.
text.en: Look forgivingly on thy flock, Eternal Shepherd, and keep it in thy constant protection, by the intercession of blessed Damasus thy Sovereign Pontiff, whom thou didst constitute Shepherd of the whole Church.

title.la: Feria II infra Hebdomadam II Adventus
title.en: Feria II infra Hebdomadam II Adventus

text.la: Ecce véniet Rex Dóminus terræ, et ipse áuferet iugum captivitátis nostræ.
text.en: Behold, the Lord cometh the King of all the earth, to take off from us the yoke of our captivity.

v.la: Roráte, cæli, désuper, et nubes pluant iustum.
v.en: Drop down dew, ye heavens, from above, and let the clouds rain the Just.

r.en: Let the earth be opened, and bud forth the Saviour.

text.la: Excita, Dómine, corda nostra ad præparándas Unigéniti tui vias: ut, per eius advéntum, purificátis tibi méntibus servíre mereámur:
text.en: Stir up our hearts, O Lord, to make ready the ways of thine Only-begotten Son, that by His coming our minds being purified, we may the more worthily give up ourselves to thy service: Who with thee liveth and reigneth, in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
